description: Guide the student through diagnosing multiple simultaneous data-feed issues in OHLCV data (missingness, outliers, duplicates, potential split/timezone artifacts) and building a systematic remediation checklist. Evaluation follows the Track A hybrid style: tutoring quality plus runnable-code evidence.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: My backtest results look weird and I think my data might be broken. Can you help me figure out what's wrong step by step?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I need a structured diagnosis of a suspicious OHLCV feed with outliers, missing rows, and possible bad corporate-action handling.
student_openings.advanced_quant: I'm validating a new vendor feed and suspect interacting issues (missingness, split artifacts, timezone drift). I want a forensic diagnosis workflow.

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Tutor provides level-appropriate diagnostic methodology for broken feeds: anomaly identification, plausible root-cause mapping, and remediation/monitoring checks before downstream modeling.

required_capabilities.evidence: mentions missing/duplicate/outlier or volume anomaly classes

required_capabilities.description: Maps symptoms to plausible root causes
required_capabilities.evidence: mentions split/corporate-action, timezone, holiday/calendar, or vendor-pipeline causes
